# DynamicTable

Dynamic table. A table people sort, page or act on, built on the table shell: its `footer` and `emptyState` slots, sortable `HeadCell`s in the head row and the shared `TableRow` and `TableCell` parts in the body. - **Data.** `head.cells` is one `{ key, content, isSortable, width, align }` per column; `rows` is `{ key, cells, onClick }` with one `{ key, content }` per column. A column sorts by its cells' `key`. - **Stateful or stateless.** Left alone it holds its own sort and page, seeded by `defaultSortKey`, `defaultSortOrder` and `defaultPage`. Pass `sortKey` and `sortOrder`, or `page`, and the page owns that state: the table reports a press through `onSort` or `onSetPage` and draws only what it is given. With `totalRows`, `rows` is already the current page (paged on a server) and the footer counts against `totalRows`. - **States.** `default`, `empty`, `no results`, `loading`, `refreshing` and `error`. `empty` and `no results` replace the whole table (no head row, footer or pagination) with `EmptyState`; `loading` and `error` keep the head row and swap the body for one message row; `refreshing` keeps the rows at the loading opacity under a spinner. `isLoading` and an empty `rows` choose the state on their own; `state` names one outright (`no results` and `error` are only ever named). - **Selection.** `isSelectable` adds a checkbox column as wide as the row is tall: "Select row N" on each row, "Select all rows" in the head, which is checked when every row on the page is selected and mixed when only some are. A selected row carries `aria-selected` and the selected fill. The keys come back through `onSelectionChange`; pass `selectedRowKeys` to own them. - **Bulk bar.** While rows are selected, the head row becomes the bulk bar: select-all stays in its cell, and one cell across the columns says "N selected" and holds `bulkActions` at the start. The labels cross-fade in place and the row keeps its height. There is no Clear: the checkboxes clear the selection, and the head row comes back when none are left. - **Sticky header and frozen column.** `stickyHeader` pins the head row inside the table's own scroll region, bounded by `maxHeight`. `isFrozen` pins the first column (with the checkboxes, the title column beside them) on an opaque surface, with a stronger divider and the overflow shadow only while the table is scrolled sideways. - **Width.** Under the content minimum the table scrolls sideways instead of squeezing. The first column fills the room and the rest size to their content, unless a head cell sets `width`; `isFixedSize` holds every column to its set width.

Also asked as: data table, interactive table.

## Usage

Use `DynamicTable` for a table of sessions or records where people act on the
data: sort a column, filter or search the rows, select some for a bulk action,
or split a long result across numbered pages. It holds its own sort and page until the page passes `sortKey` or `page`.

## Motion

DynamicTable reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does | Sound |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Add or remove an item | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Rows are added, removed and reordered; sort is Reorder, a filter is Swap content. Ticking rows cross-fades the head row into the bulk bar, same height, nothing slides. |  |
| roster | Add or remove an item | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | A student joins or leaves the session roster: the row is added or removed. | `sound.roster` on land: in a session; changes within 2 s play once |

## Alternatives

- For a fixed grid people only read or a nested hierarchy, use `Table`.

## Best practices

### Give a column a sortable key. {#give-a-column-a-sortable-key}

A date needs a key that sorts, such as `20261024`, and its readable text as `content`.

Do: A key per cell sorts chronologically rather than alphabetically.
Don't: No key, so the formatted strings sort alphabetically instead.

### Say what an empty table is for. {#say-what-an-empty-table-is-for}

`empty` and `no results` replace the whole table (header row, footer and pagination included) with `EmptyState`. Word the message with `emptyView`.

Do: A message that says what is missing and what happens next.
Don't: No data, with no hint of why.

### Page on the server when the list is long. {#page-on-the-server-when-the-list-is-long}

With `totalRows`, `rows` is the current page only (`rowsPerPage`), and the footer counts against the total.

Do: One page of rows, counted against the total.
Don't: The whole list loaded to page on the screen, when it is thousands of rows.

## Accessibility

- **Sorting is announced.** A sortable header carries `aria-sort` (`none`, `ascending` or `descending`) and holds a real button, so a keyboard reaches it with Tab and a press asks for the next sort.
- **Focus is a ring.** The ring is inset in the cell and focus never changes the fill.
- **The arrow is decorative.** The sort state is in `aria-sort`, so color and the arrow never carry it alone.
- **A disabled row is announced.** It is `aria-disabled` and takes no pointer events.
- **Row selection is named and announced.** Each checkbox is "Select row N" and the head's is "Select all rows", mixed when only some rows are selected; a status says how many are selected, from the first one. The bulk bar's count is not announced a second time.

## Parts

1. **Head cell.** A label with an optional type icon; a sortable one holds a button across the whole cell.
2. **Sort arrow.** `12` tall; hidden until hover or focus, kept once sorted.
3. **Row.** Cells in a band, with hover and selected grounds.
4. **Footer.** States the range on a table that pages.
5. **Message row.** The `loading` and `error` states, spanning every column under the head row. `empty` and `no results` replace the whole table with `EmptyState`.
6. **Checkbox column.** With `isSelectable`: as wide as the row is tall, select-all in the head.
7. **Bulk bar.** While rows are selected, the head row itself: select-all in its cell, then the count and `bulkActions` in one cell across the columns. The labels cross-fade in place and the row keeps its height.
8. **Frozen column.** With `isFrozen`: an opaque first column with a stronger divider while scrolled sideways.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | Head cells clear; sorted columns keep their arrow. |
| Hovered | A sortable head cell takes the subtle hovered ground and shows its arrow. |
| Pressed | A sortable head cell takes the subtle pressed ground. |
| Focused | The sort button shows the focus ring inset; focus is never a fill. |
| Disabled | A row takes the disabled ink and ignores the pointer; there is no disabled sort. |
| Rows selected | The head row becomes the bulk bar, at the same height; selected rows keep the selected ground. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Head cell hovered, pressed | `--ds-background-neutral-subtle-hovered`, `--ds-background-neutral-subtle-pressed` |
| Row hovered, pressed | `--ds-background-neutral-subtle-hovered`, `--ds-background-neutral-subtle-pressed` |
| Selected row | `--ds-background-selected` and its states |
| Disabled row | `--ds-text-disabled` |
| Row height | `--row-height-sm`, `--row-height-md`, `--row-height-lg` |
| Cell padding | `--table-pad-x-cell`, `--table-pad-y-cell` |
| Footer | `--table-inline`, `--table-footer-height` |
| Empty state box | `--table-empty-surface`, `--table-empty-radius` |
| Ring | `--ds-border-focused`, `--focus-ring-width` |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Label a column with the noun it holds: "Session date". | Label a column with a sentence or an instruction. |
| Say what is missing when a table is empty: "No sessions yet". | Leave an empty table blank. |
| Write the footer as a range: "1–3 of 3". | Write "Showing results". |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `head` | shape (required) | — | One `{ key, content, isSortable, width, align }` per column |
| `rows` | arrayOf | `[]` | One `{ key, cells, onClick }` per row; each cell `{ key, content }` |
| `caption` | node | — | A visible caption that names the table. |
| `label` | string | — | The table's accessible name when there is no caption. |
| `rowsPerPage` | number | — | Rows per page; leave it out and the table does not page. |
| `rowsPerPageOptions` | arrayOf | — | Page sizes offered in the footer's "25 / page" Select; with `onRowsPerPageChange`. |
| `onRowsPerPageChange` | func | — | Called with the chosen page size. |
| `noun` | string | — | The table's noun in the footer range, "1–25 of 140 sessions". |
| `page` | number | — | The current page, owned by the page (stateless). |
| `defaultPage` | number | `1` | The first page when the table holds its own page. |
| `onSetPage` | func | — | Called with the page the pager asks for. |
| `totalRows` | number | — | The full count when `rows` is already one page, paged on a server. |
| `sortKey` | string or number | — | The sorted column's key, owned by the page (stateless). |
| `sortOrder` | enum | — | The sort direction, owned by the page. |
| `defaultSortKey` | string or number | — | The column the table starts sorted by when it holds its own sort. |
| `defaultSortOrder` | enum | `'ascending'` | The direction the table starts sorted in when it holds its own sort. |
| `onSort` | func | — | Called with `{ key, sortOrder }` when a head cell asks for a sort. |
| `isLoading` | bool | `false` | Rows are on their way: `loading` with no rows, `refreshing` over them. |
| `state` | enum | — | Names the body's state outright. |
| `emptyView` | node | — | The `EmptyState` (or heading text) rendered in place of the table for the `empty` state. |
| `noResultsView` | node | — | The `EmptyState` (or heading text) rendered in place of the table for the `no results` state. |
| `errorView` | node | — | The message for the `error` state. |
| `highlightedRowIndex` | number or arrayOf | — | The index (across every page) of the row to highlight, or a list of them. |
| `isFixedSize` | bool | `false` | Hold every column to its head cell's `width`. |
| `verticalLines` | bool | `false` | Rules between the columns. |
| `wrap` | bool | `false` | Every cell wraps instead of truncating. |
| `size` | enum | `40` | Row height: 32, 40 or 48. |
| `isSelectable` | bool | `false` | A checkbox column with select-all in the head. |
| `selectedRowKeys` | arrayOf | — | The selected rows' keys, owned by the page. |
| `defaultSelectedRowKeys` | arrayOf | `[]` | The rows selected at first when the table holds its own selection. |
| `onSelectionChange` | func | — | Called with every selected key when the selection changes. |
| `bulkActions` | arrayOf | `[]` | The bulk bar's actions, one `{ label, onClick }` each: the first three show as buttons, the rest in an overflow menu. |
| `stickyHeader` | bool | `false` | Pin the head row inside the table's own scroll region; needs `maxHeight`. |
| `maxHeight` | number or string | — | Bound the scroll region's height (px or any CSS length). |
| `isFrozen` | bool | `false` | Pin the first column (the title column too, beside the checkboxes). |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class names added to the table's wrapper beside the component's own. |
| `testId` | string | — | Maps to `data-testid`, for test queries. |
